notes: The landing page says grades 6 to 10 across middle and high school sessions; the high school page says grades 9 to 10.
name: UMSL Bridge Program Summer Academy
org: University of Missouri-St. Louis, Office of Precollegiate Student Services
what_you_do: Weekday mornings from mid June to mid July on the UMSL campus. Freshmen and sophomores get math, science and writing workshops and career planning.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 9 to 10 at a St. Louis area school with a 2.5 or higher GPA. You must be in or past Algebra. You need a transcript, a behavior report and a teacher or counselor recommendation.
pay_detail: UMSL's landing page calls its Bridge services free. No pay.
duration: Mid-June to mid-July, Monday to Friday 7:45 a.m. to 12 p.m. (2026 high school session began June 22)
deadline_text: The 2026 extended deadline was May 29, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the UMSL Bridge page when it is taking students. Send a transcript, behavior report and recommendation form.
